summary: Barnwell Industries filed an 8-K disclosing an October 5, 2026 Share Purchase and Sale Agreement to sell its Canadian oil and gas business to 2798913 Alberta Ltd. Base purchase price is C$9,000,000, comprising C$4,000,000 cash and a 5% royalty valued at C$5,000,000, subject to working-capital and indebtedness adjustments; the board recommends shareholder approval. A pre-closing reorganization amalgamates Barnwell Canada and Octavian into Barnwell of Canada, Limited and issues a C$8,750,000 vendor promissory note. Watch shareholder vote timing, working-capital true-up, royalty enforcement, and retained-asset leakage.
